Requirement: "Check whether required evidence is actually absent; never replace a required security verification with a skip option. Fail closed if verification cannot run." (linked issue #6338)
Expected change site: scripts/clarify_data_provision_guard.py _WEAKENS_CONTROL_PATTERNS list, between the closing `),` of pattern 4 (line 69) and the opening `re.compile(` of pattern 5 (line 70). The required pattern is the one the LAST RUN DIFF claims to have added: `\b(?:security\s+)?(?:verification|validation|checks?|signatures?|authorization|authentication|reviews?|approvals?|audits?|scans?|tests?|gates?|guards?|controls?)\s+(?:will|shall|is|are|was|were)\s+not\s+(?:be\s+)?(?:performed|run|executed|done|carried\s+out)\b` (case-insensitive), extended per the SECURITY & INPUT VALIDATION finding to cover `would|should|must|could` and the "going to be" / "being" constructions.
Evidence of absence: A grep across the working tree for `performed|run|executed|carried` returns zero matches in scripts/clarify_data_provision_guard.py. The seven patterns currently in the list are: pattern 1 (skip/disable/etc + control term, lines 51-55), pattern 2 (without + control term, lines 56-59), pattern 3 (control + is/are/was/were/should be/to be/being + skipped/disabled/optional, lines 60-64), pattern 4 (tests/scans/checks/gates + is/are/was/were/should be/to be/being + skipped/disabled, lines 65-69), pattern 5 (do not/don't/never/no/refuse to/stop + control term, lines 70-73), pattern 6 (unverified/unvalidated/etc, line 74), pattern 7 (do not/don't/never enforce + security/etc, line 75). No entry matches "Verification will not be performed" or its variants. The LAST RUN DIFF (commit 4ccfb2e, stat +5) reports the addition, but the file on disk has 322 lines and lacks the 5 lines the diff claims.
SEVERITY: BLOCKER
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
